subject: SIG packaging and consolidated export for AcmeCloud procurement
messages:
From: AcmeCloud Procurement <procurement@acmecloud.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: John Park <john.park@acmecloud.com>
Date: 2026-01-07T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: SIG + evidence package request for procurement review

Hi Vivek,

We are kicking off the security review for Redwood as part of our Q1 procurement cycle. Our security team requested the completed SIG questionnaire plus supporting evidence for the controls marked as "In Scope" in the attached checklist. We prefer a consolidated PDF export for intake to our OneTrust portal, but we can accept portal uploads if you have a standard mapping.

Key asks:
- Completed SIG (latest) in PDF format
- Supporting artifacts for SOC 2 controls (system config snapshots, policy excerpts, recent audit report)
- A short manifest mapping each attachment to SIG question IDs

Target date: Jan 15 for upload. Can you confirm approach and timeline?

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Procurement, AcmeCloud

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: AcmeCloud Procurement <procurement@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-01-07T11:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SIG + evidence package request for procurement review

Hi Samantha,

Thanks — we can deliver a procurement-ready packet by Jan 15. Proposed approach:

1) Produce a consolidated PDF export that contains the filled SIG with embedded references to evidence items.
2) Include a separate export-manifest CSV (SIG question ID -> filename -> short description).
3) Perform incremental portal uploads to OneTrust (bulk PDF + manifest) if you prefer portal ingest; we can do both so you have the archive and the portal entries.

Monica will assemble the artifacts and Karthik will coordinate the upload and checksums. A couple quick clarifying Qs: do you want any internal IP redacted from screenshots, and will the portal accept zipped attachments or only individual PDFs?

Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-01-08T08:05:00-08:00
Subject: SIG packaging plan and attachments (draft)

Vivek / Karthik — draft plan from the security delivery side:

- Produce: SIG_Responses_20260107.pdf (filled SIG with answer justification footers).
- Evidence bundle: SOC2_Evidence_2025-12.zip (contains: audit-report-2025-12.pdf, access-control-snapshots/, config-export-2025-11.json).
- Manifest: export-manifest-20260107.csv (columns: sig_id,file_name,short_desc,control_type).
- Upload log stub: ot-upload-log-20260115.txt (will contain OneTrust import IDs and checksums).

Notes / recommendations:
- PDF flattening and stamping (watermark: "Redwood Internal — For procurement review") to avoid platform rendering issues.
- We should avoid screenshots that include customer data; Monica will scrub any PII and produce redacted copies where needed.
- For evidence that is large (DB config exports), prefer zipped archive with a manifest referencing specific files.

I will assemble everything and run it through our internal preflight (checksum, manifest validation, page count). Expected: first pack by Jan 12 for internal review, final upload Jan 15.

Attachments (draft): SIG_Responses_20260107.pdf; export-manifest-20260107.csv; SOC2_Evidence_2025-12.zip

—Monica
Security Delivery Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmecloud.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: John Park <john.park@acmecloud.com>
Date: 2026-01-09T10:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SIG packaging plan and attachments (draft)

Vivek / Monica — thanks for the plan. OneTrust is preferred. A couple items from our side:

- Please include a short "security contact" one-pager (name, email, phone) for our ATO liaison.
- We accept zipped evidence for large artifacts, but each zip must have a top-level manifest and individual file checksums.
- If you can upload directly to our OneTrust portal we will mark the package as received; otherwise we can accept a pre-signed SFTP upload.

Jan 15 upload deadline is good. Appreciate the watermark approach.

Regards,
Samantha Lee
Procurement, AcmeCloud

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-01-12T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Portal upload checklist + technical notes

Team — technical checklist for OneTrust bulk import:

- Filenames: use kebab-case with date prefix (e.g., 20260107-sig-responses.pdf).
- PDF: flattened, no incremental xref, embedded fonts.
- Manifest: export-manifest-20260107.csv (utf-8, CRLF ok, fields: sig_id,file_name,sha256).
- Zip: include top-level manifest.csv and checksums.txt.
- Compute SHA256 checksums and include ot-upload-log-20260115.txt with mapping to OneTrust import IDs after upload.

Upload options:
1) Direct OneTrust portal bulk upload (we need portal access token from Acme).
2) Pre-signed SFTP drop (preferred if Acme cannot grant portal access).

Related link: https://app.onetrust.com/help/bulk-pdf-upload-guidance
Pre-signed SFTP stub: sftp://uploads.redwoodinference.com/pre-signed/acme-20260115 (expires 2026-01-16)

I will run a quick validation job on Jan 14 to ensure checksums and manifest lines match.

—Karthik
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: AcmeCloud Procurement <procurement@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-01-15T17:42:00-08:00
Subject: SIG package uploaded to OneTrust (AcmeCloud) — please confirm receipt

Samantha / team — we completed the delivery. Summary below: 

Upload method: OneTrust portal bulk import (Acme tenant)
Files uploaded: SIG_Responses_20260107.pdf; SOC2_Evidence_2025-12.zip; export-manifest-20260107.csv
Upload log: ot-upload-log-20260115.txt (attached) — contains OneTrust import IDs and SHA256 checksums.
OneTrust link: https://acme.onetrust.com/portal/bulk-upload/ABCD-1234

Security contact: Vivek Kulkarni, vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com, +1 (415) 555-0147

Next steps: please confirm that the portal shows the package as "Received" and let us know if you need any additional redaction or expanded artifacts. If you prefer a DocuSign acknowledgment, we can issue that as well.

Thanks for working with us.

—Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Attachments: SIG_Responses_20260107.pdf; SOC2_Evidence_2025-12.zip; export-manifest-20260107.csv; ot-upload-log-20260115.txt
